mItemDataClient.mDescription:
%i:scaleSV% @Omnivamp*100@% Omnivamp against jungle monsters
  • Sear: Damaging jungle monsters burns them for @TotalBurnDamage@ magic damage over @Effect3Amount@ seconds.
  • Challenging Path: Smiting 5 times consumes this item and upgrades your Smite to Challenging Smite, increasing its damage to monsters to @TooltipUpgradedSmiteValue@ and damage to minions to @TooltipMinionDamageFlat@ +@TooltipMinionDamagePercentHealth*100@% target max Health. Challenging Smite marks champions for @ImmolatingMarkDuration@ seconds. Damaging a marked champion deals an additional @ImmolatingBurnDamageTooltip@ true damage to them over @ImmolatingBurnDuration@ seconds. You take @ImmolatingReductionPercent*100@% reduced damage from marked champions.
  • Huntsman: Killing large jungle monsters grants bonus experience.
  • Recoup: Regen up to @ManaRestoreForTooltip@ Mana (based on missing mana) per second when in the jungle or river.

    Consuming this item grants all item effects permanently and increases Smite damage to monsters. If you have gained more gold from minions than jungle monsters, gold and experience from minions is heavily reduced. Healing is not reduced on AoE attacks. If two levels behind the average champion level of the game, monster kills grant bonus experience.
    Only attacks and abilities apply Challenging Smite's burn

Summon a Mosstomper that assists you against monsters.

The companion grows as you hunt monsters, empowering your Smite. When fully grown, it completes your Jungle Quest and grants a Shield while out of combat and after killing large monsters.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Jungle Companions
Summon a Mosstomper who deals @spell.SummonerSmite:PetDPS@ damage, heals you for @spell.SummonerSmite:PetHPS@ per second, makes you deal @spell.PuppyControllerBuff:DamageAmp*100@% damage and take @spell.PuppyControllerBuff:MonsterDamageTaken*100@% damage against monsters.

Mosstomper's Courage
The companion grows as you hunt monsters, empowering your Smite. When fully grown, it grants a @MaxShield@ damage shield that regenerates after killing large monsters or @AvatarDamageCD@ seconds out of combat.
  • The companion can be fed up to @TotalCounters@ Treats. When you kill a large monster you feed it once, twice if you have bonus treats. You periodically get bonus treats to feed to your companion which also grant bonus gold.
  • @Breakpoint1@ Treats: Your Smite deals @spell.SummonerSmite:SmiteUpgradedDamage@ damage. It can be cast on enemy champions to deal reduced damage and Slow them.
  • @TotalCounters@ Treats: Your Smite deals @spell.SummonerSmite:Smite2ndUpgradedDamage@ damage to nearby monsters.

    Gain an additional @spell.PuppyControllerBuff:TreatXP@ experience per large or epic monster killed and @spell.PuppyControllerBuff:FirstMonsterBonusXP@ additional experience from the first.
    Killing a large or epic monster restores up to @spell.Monster_Heal_Mis:MinHealTooltip@-@spell.Monster_Heal_Mis:BaseHealCap@ Health and @spell.Monster_Heal_Mis:MinManaTooltip@-@spell.Monster_Heal_Mis:MaxManaTooltip@ Mana.

  • Voidborn Resilience: For each second in champion combat gain a stack granting @FlatResistsPerStack@ Armor and Magic Resist, up to @MaxStacks@ stacks max.   • Absorb: Taking magic damage from enemy Champions grants a stack of Steadfast (max @MaxStacks@) for @BuffDuration@ seconds. Enemy Immobilizing effects grant an additional @ImmobilizeStacks@ stacks.
  • Dissipate: While at @MaxStacks@ stacks of Steadfast, gain @BonusMagicResist@ Magic Resist and @MoveSpeed*100@% increased Move Speed.
    One spell can add a new stack of Steadfast every @StackRefreshTimer@ second.
    • "He has been called many things. A carapace helm. A second skin. A living tomb..."
